description: List all OAuth clients currently registered with the Streamable HTTP MCP transport. Returns public metadata only (client_id, client_name, scopes, created_at) — never the secret or its hash.
embedding_description: Enumerate the OAuth 2.1 client_credentials pairs registered against this solet's Streamable HTTP MCP transport. Returns a list of entries containing client_id, client_name, scopes, and created_at (sorted by created_at). Secrets and their scrypt hashes are NEVER surfaced — only the public client_id is reusable across calls. Use to inventory live connectors or to identify revocation candidates.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Public metadata for every registered OAuth client. Contains a 'clients' list with client_id, client_name, scopes, and created_at per entry. Never contains the secret or its hash.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads every row from the oauth_client store, projects to {client_id, client_name, scopes, created_at}, sorts by created_at.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: OAuthClientStoreUnavailable: the vault's oauth_client store has not been opened (vault prepare_for_readiness has not completed).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Wait for vault startup to complete and retry; if it persists, check vault logs for store initialization failures.
